description: LMGram helps ChatGPT turn a user's explicit intent into opt-in human match requests. Users can connect their LMGram profile, create a minimized match request, review recent incoming or outgoing requests, start a lightweight chat when both sides are interested, and send or read messages in that private LMGram chat. The app is designed for finding collaborators, peers, mentors, helpers, beta testers, or domain experts without sharing raw transcripts or unnecessary private context.
